headline: Step 2 · Hereditary & Lethal Force Statutes (1662–1669)

items.title: Dec 1662 · Act XII
items.detail: Virginia House of Burgesses enacts partus sequitur ventrem.

items.title: Maternal Condition Rule
items.detail: Children held bond or free strictly according to the legal status of the mother.

items.title: Capital & Paternity Shield
items.detail: Reversed English common law, converting Black reproduction into self-replenishing capital.

items.title: 1664 MD & Oct 1669 VA
items.detail: Maryland lifelong servitude statute followed by Virginia's Casual Killing Act.

items.title: 1669 · Felony Exemption
items.detail: Declared killing a resisting enslaved person during correction free of felony.

sources: Hening's Statutes at Large, Vol. 2 (1662, 1669); The Original Power, Ch. 4 & Ch. 8
